loadout.label: Poco / Redmi / iQOO mid-range phone
loadout.note: Tandem-core Snapdragon/Dimensity chips at this tier run FF at stable 60/90 FPS on high. Don't overspend past this band just for ranked.

loadout.label: Tempered glass for that phone
loadout.note: Free Fire gloves at 4 AM on steam. One drop ruins a ₹25k screen; glass is ₹150 insurance.

loadout.label: Neckband / wired earphones
loadout.note: Wired beats wireless for footsteps and gunshot direction. Call out shots, win more duels.

loadout.label: Cooling pad or back clip fan
loadout.note: Thermal throttling is the 2 AM enemy — the frame rate you grind rises and falls with skin temperature.

loadout.label: Charger / power bank
loadout.note: Café skirmishes eat 20% battery an hour. Never queue on 14%.

loadout.label: Finger sleeve (fiber)
loadout.note: Sweat is not aim control. ₹100 for reliable drag-taps.
